environment.description: Terraform provider runs as a pod in namespace 'terraform-runners' on a Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the mesh level with a DENY action for source principals not matching 'cluster.local/ns/terraform-runners/sa/terraform-provider-dns'. However, the command injection executes locally within the pod itself (nsupdate runs on localhost), so the Istio sidecar proxy only governs outbound L7 traffic to other mesh services. A PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS mesh-wide. The dns-api-service in namespace 'dns-system' has an additional AuthorizationPolicy that only allows requests from source namespace 'dns-controllers'. Note: the provider does NOT call dns-api-service over HTTP; it shells out to nsupdate which uses DNS protocol (UDP/TCP port 53) directly to config.DNSServer.
